mappings.subject: Punishment for Murder
mappings.key_change: Punishment penalty structure preserved; section number changed to 103(1).

mappings.subject: Culpable Homicide Not Amounting to Murder
mappings.key_change: Enhanced clarity on degree of intent and punishment parameters.

mappings.subject: Punishment for Rape
mappings.key_change: Minimum sentence increased to 10 years; gender-neutral victim language in specific sub-clauses.

mappings.subject: Cheating and Dishonestly Inducing Delivery of Property
mappings.key_change: Higher monetary fine options and expanded scope for electronic cheating.

mappings.subject: Husband or Relative of Husband Subjecting Woman to Cruelty
mappings.key_change: Section reorganized under Chapter V (Offences Against Woman & Child).

mappings.subject: Defamation
mappings.key_change: Introduced Community Service as alternative punishment.

mappings.subject: Acts Endangering Sovereignty, Unity and Integrity of India
mappings.key_change: Sedition term removed; specific focus on secessionist activity, armed rebellion, and sovereignty threats.

mappings.subject: Arrest by Police without Warrant
mappings.key_change: DSP rank permission needed before arresting infirm/elderly for minor offences.

mappings.subject: Information in Cognizable Cases (FIR)
mappings.key_change: Mandated Zero FIR and e-FIR registration across all police stations.

mappings.subject: Remand & Police Custody
mappings.key_change: Police custody of 15 days can be sought in split spells across 40/60 days.

mappings.subject: Bail in Non-Bailable Offences & First Time Undertrials
mappings.key_change: Mandatory release on bail for first-time offenders completing 1/3rd max sentence.

mappings.subject: Admissibility of Electronic Records
mappings.key_change: Expanded definition to include cloud storage, smartphone logs, and digital messages.

mappings.subject: Confession to Police Officer
mappings.key_change: Custodial confession bar preserved to protect constitutional rights.

mappings.subject: Burden of Proof
mappings.key_change: Harmonized evidentiary rules across modern electronic and physical trials.
